name: EVE The Fatal Attraction
source:
"Eve: The Fatal Attraction" is a chapter in EVE series, and is based on the hentai PC game  Adam: The Double Factor. Its scenario was expanded in this game up to the point of being a sequel to "Adam". It adds many Eve: Burst Error and Eve: The Lost One references, lots of new events, 2 more days and proper ending to the game.

You control the two main heroes of the game, the young careless detective Kojiroh and the sexy red-haired super-spy Marina. The events of the game are connected to their previous investigation (in Eve Burst Error). Kojiroh's ex-girlfriend and colleague, Yayoi Katsuragi, receives a case: somebody is threatening the life of two young girls, Mika and Miki, the daughters of the owner of the powerful Andou Corporation. Naturally, Yayoi needs Kojiroh's help, and here the investigation truly begins!

Like in other Eve games, you control two characters in two "scenarios", and sometimes the cooperation between them is necessary. The game utilizes the same "Touchable View" that was implemented in "Adam": you interact with the environment and with the characters not by selecting menu options, but by moving the cursor around and clicking on objects, like in Western point-and-click adventures.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/playstation/eve-the-fatal-attraction]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《EVE The Fatal Attraction》是《EVE》系列的一章，改编自成人PC游戏《ADAM THE DOUBLE FACTOR》。本作大幅扩充了原有剧本，几乎可视为《ADAM》的续篇。游戏加入许多对《EVE burst error》和《EVE The Lost One》的引用、大量新事件、额外两天剧情，以及一个完整结局。

玩家将操纵两名主要角色：年轻而粗枝大叶的侦探天城小次郎，以及性感的红发超级特工法条麻理奈。本作事件与他们之前在《EVE burst error》中的调查有关。小次郎的前女友兼同事桂木弥生接到一桩案件：有人正威胁实力雄厚的安藤集团所有者的两个女儿——美佳与美纪——的生命。弥生自然需要小次郎的帮助，真正的调查就此开始！

与其他《EVE》作品一样，玩家要在两个“剧本”中分别操纵两名角色，有时必须让他们相互配合。游戏采用与《ADAM》相同的“Touchable View”系统：玩家并非通过选择菜单选项与环境和角色互动，而是像西式点击式冒险游戏那样移动光标、点击物体。
